definitions.def: to set up or create something that will last
a feeling or thought that is not based on truth
ready to do something even though it is difficult
to face a difficult situation directly
to provide someone with what is needed for a task

grammar_choice.en_template: A first step toward {{1:establishing/established}} a respectful classroom learning community {{2:is/are}} acceptance of all ideas and answers regardless of any obvious errors.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 존중하는 교실 학습 공동체를 확립하는 첫 단계는, 명백한 오류가 있더라도 모든 아이디어와 답변을 수용하는 것이다.
explain: 주어는 단수 명사 'A first step' → is.

grammar_choice.en_template: Rich mathematical discussions cannot {{1:occur/be occurred}} if this expectation {{2:is/being}} not in place.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 이러한 기대가 마련되지 않으면 풍부한 수학적 토론은 일어날 수 없다.
explain: if절은 정상 동사 형태 is 필요(분사구 아님).

grammar_choice.en_template: We must remember {{1:that/what}} wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions, and unless these ideas {{2:are allowed/allow}} to be brought to the forefront, we cannot help students {{3:confront/to confront}} their thinking.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 틀린 답은 종종 오개념에 뿌리를 두므로, 이러한 생각이 전면에 드러나지 않으면 학생이 자신의 사고와 직면하도록 도울 수 없다.
explain: remember의 목적어 명사절 → 완전한 문장 유도하는 접속사 that.
ideas가 'be brought'의 대상 → 수동 are allowed.
help + (to) V — 원형 또는 to부정사, 일반적으로 원형 confront.

grammar_choice.en_template: Students {{1:who/whom}} are in safe learning environments are willing to risk {{2:sharing/to share}} an incorrect answer with their peers in order to grow mathematically.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 안전한 학습 환경의 학생들은 수학적으로 성장하기 위해 틀린 답을 동료와 공유하는 위험을 기꺼이 감수한다.
explain: 선행사 Students(사람) + 뒤 절의 주어 역할 → 주격 who.
risk + V-ing — risk는 동명사를 목적어로 취함.

grammar_choice.en_template: It is important {{1:to model/modeling}} and expect the acceptance of all ideas {{2:without/with}} derogatory comments.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 경멸하는 발언 없이 모든 아이디어를 받아들이는 것을 모범으로 보이고 기대하는 것이 중요하다.

grammar_choice.en_template: As educators we can model this by {{1:recording/record}} all answers to be considered without giving any verbal or physical expressions {{2:that/what}} indicate agreement or disagreement.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 교사로서 우리는 어떤 답변에도 동의·반대를 나타내는 언어적·신체적 표현 없이, 고려할 모든 답변을 기록함으로써 이것을 모범으로 보일 수 있다.
explain: 선행사 expressions를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that.

grammar_choice.en_template: The teacher may need {{1:to practice/practice}} {{2:having/to have}} a "blank face."
grammar_choice.ko_full: 교사는 "무표정"을 유지하는 것을 연습할 필요가 있을 수 있다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Students {{1:look to/look up}} teachers as the {{2:source/sourcing}} of correct answers.
Part of building a safe learning community {{1:is/are}} to shift this source of knowledge to the students by {{2:equipping/equip}} them to defend the thinking behind their solutions.

jumble.answer: A first step toward establishing a respectful classroom learning community is acceptance of all ideas and answers regardless of any obvious errors.
Rich mathematical discussions cannot occur if this expectation is not in place.
We must remember that wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions, and unless these ideas are allowed to be brought to the forefront, we cannot help students confront their thinking.
Students who are in safe learning environments are willing to risk sharing an incorrect answer with their peers in order to grow mathematically.
It is important to model and expect the acceptance of all ideas without derogatory comments.
As educators we can model this by recording all answers to be considered without giving any verbal or physical expressions that indicate agreement or disagreement.
The teacher may need to practice having a "blank face."
Students look to teachers as the source of correct answers.
Part of building a safe learning community is to shift this source of knowledge to the students by equipping them to defend the thinking behind their solutions.
